definitions: A large hole in the ground, either natural or artificial.
A coal mine or the shaft of a coal mine.
The stone of a fruit, such as a cherry or peach.
A sunken area in a workshop or garage floor for inspecting the underside of vehicles.
An area at the side of a racetrack for servicing vehicles during a race.
examples: The hikers fell into a deep pit.
He spent thirty years working down the pit.
Remove the pit from the olive.
The car pulled into the pit for a tyre change.
